name: DeLaurenti Prosecco
description: Our very own prosecco from just outside Trieste. Crisp, dry and delicious. There is no prosecco season - this wine is good 12 months a year!

name: Angol d'Amig 'Pulonia' Emilia Bianco Frizzante IGP
description:
Winemaker Marco Lanzotti is quietly making some of the most exciting sparkling wines in Modena. His Pulonia cuvée is a golden-yellow expression of Pignoletto* and Trebbiano Modenese. It's simultaneously soft and nutty and bright and citrusy. The mousse on this pet-nat frizzante is fine, albeit a little more rustic than what you might expect from sparkling wine vinified in the traditional method. Given the wine's origins, it's hard to imagine a better pairing for this wine than rustic salumi or Parmigiano Reggiano-forward dishes.

*Pignoletto is not formally recognized as a grape name anymore, as the grape was proven genetically identical to Grechetto di Todi/Grechetto Gentile. The name now refers to the DOC where white wines are made of this grape, but clearly, some wineries are still holding on to the grape's traditional name.

name: Angol d'Amig 'Scaramusc' Lambrusco dell'Emilia IGT
tagline: Emilia, IT - 2022 - Lambrusco Grasparossa, Lambrusco di Sorbara, Lambrusco Salamino
description: Lambrusco comes in many shapes and styles these days, but Marco Lanzotti's Scaramusc might just be one of the most intense and brooding that we have in the shop. But, despite it's intense blackberry and richer savory notes, the wine comes in under twelve percent alcohol and feels quite light on the palate.  A dry and refreshing treat while you snack on Reggiano, mortadella, and grissini while you wait for your pizza to come out of the oven.

name: Aval Cidre Blanc 12oz
description: Lightly tannic and massively approachable, this cider, comprised of fresh-pressed juice from sour apples, is a pristine example of classic Bretagne cider. Mineral-driven with bright fruit notes, this dry cider is an excellent option with paella, lighter soups, and Thai food.

name: Aval Cidre Gold 12oz
description: Classic French profile, composed of bitter and bittersweet apples ideal for quality cider. Bold and slightly musky, the Aval Gold is a great alternative to a blanc de blancs style Champagne, perfect with cured meats and spicy curry.

name: Aval Cidre Rose 12oz
description: This cider gets its color from sour, red-fleshed apples and is dry, slightly tannic, and a great bridge to cider if you're a fan of sparkling rose wine. It makes a refreshing pairing for rich, creamy cheeses and a great apertif.

name: Jean-Louis Denois "Classique" Brut
tagline: Limoux, FR - Pinot Noir, Syrah, Chardonnay - NV
description: A joyous, fruit-driven sparkler from the foothills of the Pyrenees. Jean-Louis Denois blends Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and a touch of Syrah to create a wine with fine bubbles, almond and dried red-berry notes, and surprising depth for the price. Crisp, clean, and thoroughly charming.

name: Lini 910 Lambrusco Rosso
tagline: Emilia-Romagna, IT - Lambrusco Salamino, Ancellotta - NV
description: This Lambrusco is totally dry, fully sparkling, and charming enough to make pizza swoon. The wine defies convention and dazzles the palate with lush berry notes and tinges of earthy spice. It’s the perfect wine for pizza lovers and oenophiles alike. A sip or two and you’ll understand why this wine is having a moment right now.
